keys.axe: \baxe\b|\bhatchet|\b(a|my|the) saw\b|\bsaws\b|\bsawing|\bchop|cut (it|you|the tree|your tree|this tree|that tree) down|burn (it|you|the tree|your tree|this tree) down|\blumber
keys.echoback: \becho(ing)?\b.{0,20}\b(back|you|it)\b|\*\s*i echo|repeat\w* (it|that|your words|its words|what it said) back

lines.opener: *somewhere among the roots, your own footsteps answer you* ...steps... ...eps... *a small pale head peeks out and rattles like dry seeds*
lines.openerHostile: *the roots in the vault creak; a pale shape glares down from among them* ...who?... ...who comes?... ...comes...
lines.hate: *every leaf in the dark goes still. Then the roots move.* ...CUT... ...CUT... ...CUT...
lines.join: *it slips out from the roots and echoes your footsteps, right behind you* ...with... ...with you... ...you...
lines.demand: *it points at its own mouth, then up the tunnel, where the echoes go* ...breath?... ...a little?... ...carry...
lines.gift: *it rolls a bead of amber sap to your feet* ...old... ...old tree... ...heals...
lines.thanks: *your breath goes out of you, and comes back from far away, many times* ...thank... ...ank... ...you...
lines.letPass: *it fades back into the roots* ...go... ...go on... ...on...
lines.neutral: *it echoes the end of what you said, very faintly*
